newsitem.title: USA: Ziegler Cos Inc to acquire Milwaukee firms.
newsitem.headline: Ziegler Cos Inc to acquire Milwaukee firms.

text.p: Ziegler Cos Ins said Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Glaisner, Schilffarth, Grande & Schnoll Ltd and its investment advisory unit, GS2 Securities, in a deal worth at least $2.75 million.
Ziegler will provide common stock and may pay as much as $1 million more depending on the financial performance of GS2 following the sale, the buyer said.
Founded in 1993, Glaisner, Schilffarth is a Milwaukee-based financial services provider.
Ziegler is a financial services holding company.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Monday at 19.
